body:
# 🐞 Bug report ### Command ``` - [x] serve ``` ### Is this a regression? Yes? I didn't use AOT for dev mode serving previously because it wasn't as performant as it is now in Ivy. ### Description The [Ivy Guide](https://angular.io/guide/ivy) suggests enabling `"aot": true` for dev mode builds. What I’m finding during that experience is that while the rebuilds are super fast in Dev mode (`aot: true`), the Angular CLI often doesn’t pick up changes to SCSS and HTML. I need to constantly re-run `ng serve` over and over again to see my changes. It’s not the kind of DX that we’re looking for. Changing back to `aot: false` works around this issue. ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction - https://github.com/angular-hispano/angular-hispano/tree/enableIvy - `npm start` - Make changes to files like the following and see that the build reports ```sh Date: 2019-06-09T02:07:26.153Z - Hash: fd4823b00365cd497714 - Time: 192ms 7 unchanged chunks ℹ ｢wdm｣: Compiled successfully. ``` But the changes aren't reflected in the browser. Change https://github.com/angular-hispano/angular-hispano/blob/18c79aaf9c075feea4bdff7c3e3f39e08f88db2e/projects/web/src/app/landing/landing.component.html#L30-L31 to ```html
``` Change https://github.com/angular-hispano/angular-hispano/blob/d5be179b0b7a428c0a9225862df33caafb330ce8/projects/web/src/app/landing/landing.component.scss#L10-L12 to ```scss &#call-to-action { display: flex; flex-flow: row wrap; padding-top: 24px; } ``` ## 🔥 Exception or Error None ## 🌍 Your Environment
